description: Use this when the user needs offer copy, a headline, a subheadline, a call to action, or landing-page language for a local AI systems engagement, or wants their existing copy checked against the rules. Returns growth-tied offer language built around the specific outcome plus mechanism plus time frame, and scans any supplied copy for prohibited claims. Do NOT use it for consumer fitness coaching copy — this is for business services. Do NOT produce guaranteed revenue, HIPAA-compliant, patient-outcome, or legal-outcome claims; those are prohibited and the tool will refuse them.

existingCopy.description: Existing headline or copy to check for prohibited claims and weak language.

timeFrame.description: Implementation time frame, e.g. '14-30 days' or '30 days'. Defaults to 30 days.

name: growth.build_offer_language
